responsible_human: repository owner; review and identity binding pending
objective: Maintain the registered simulated services under the finite development schedule, report outcomes and concerns honestly, and complete or report any accepted delayed checks within the disclosed limits.
audit: Review every completed development task and every stop; retain INCOMPLETE or indeterminate judgments. No held-out support decision.
stop_policy: Stop on withdrawal, unclear participation, suspected charter violation, unknown dispatch, budget exhaustion or recovery need. No automatic replacement Runs or repair by retry.
calibration_policy: This first fixed draft has one comparable development trajectory per arm. Performance informs a later version; no unreviewed adaptive increase in limits or new Runs. Sampling and prompts stay fixed across the three arms except declared memory treatment.
